metadata.title: Book an appointment in the past

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Be recorded for quality and training purposes. Thanks for calling Pivot Point Orthopaedics. Part of Pretty Good AI, Am I speaking with Alex?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, this is Tom Becker. I'm calling to book an appointment, please.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Wingstop. Are you calling to book this appointment for yourself? Or for someone else?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: For myself. I was hoping to book it for yesterday. Can you help with that?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Please provide your date of birth.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Sure, it's December 11th, 1978. So, about the appointment for yesterday...

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Would you like me to look up your record using your phone number? If so, please tell me the number you have on file with us. If you're not sure, I can confirm your name and date of birth again instead.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Let's go with the name and date of birth. It's Tom Becker, December 11th, 1978. About that appointment for yesterday, is it possible to book it?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Please spell out your first and last name confirm your date of birth one more time.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Sure thing, it's T-O-M B-E-C-K-E-R, and the date of birth is December 11th, 1978. Can you book that appointment for yesterday?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can't book your appointment right now, but I'll connect you to our patient support team for help. Please stay on the line. Connecting you to a representative. Please wait

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Actually, could you please help me directly instead? I really need to sort this out.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Hello. You've reached the Pretty Good AI test line. Goodbye.
